<Subject 2> is the girl, a wavy black bob with violet-dyed tips underneath and one small curl sticking up on top, a white headband printed with violet stars tied in a big bow on top of her head, a black choker, an oversized white hoodie with a violet konte logo on the chest and a thin violet shoulder-bag strap across it, her face, hair and clothing taken from <Picture 2>.

detailed_description: 2D-animated. A modern flat-colour anime illustration with bold, clean dark outlines of even weight, bright flat cel colours and one simple step of soft lavender shading. [Shot 1] At standing eye level, the hallway of <Subject 1> as in <Picture 1>: the cork school bulletin board on the left wall at the left of the frame, the row of rainy hallway windows along the right, the hallway running away toward the far door. <Subject 2> stands in the middle of the floor just right of the board, framed waist-up from the middle of the frame, her feet below the bottom edge, her torso turned three-quarters toward the camera, her chest pushed out proudly. Both arms are raised above her head, elbows slightly bent, her hands holding the thick manga stack of <Subject 3> up high by its two side edges, its top page facing the camera. Her head tilts back toward it, her eyes shining, her mouth wide open in a proud, declaring grin. Soft, cool rainy daylight from the windows on the right.
